assumption_status: Pre-outcome sensitivity grid. All Study 2 effects and opportunity rates are assumptions; no participant target is selected.
pairing: Balanced N=240 panels, 30 per cell. Comparisons with the saved N=200 results are unpaired: the original panels are not nested in these N=240 panels.
effect_status: OR=1.5 main effects and interaction OR=0.67 are inherited illustrative assumptions, with explicit smaller/larger main-effect and null sensitivities.

scenarios.name: v6_round2_smoothed_anchor
scenarios.rationale: Ten fresh complete author-confirmed screened experts; v6 materials. Descriptive sensitivity only, not Study 2 estimates; C-05 has since changed in v7.

scenarios.name: v6_round2_half_correct_ai_opportunities
scenarios.rationale: Half the smoothed first-four opportunity rates; fixed hypothetical sensitivity.

scenarios.name: v6_round2_double_correct_ai_opportunities

scenarios.name: v7_C05_recoverability_50_assumption

scenarios.name: v7_C05_recoverability_85_assumption
scenarios.rationale: Assume .85 correct unaided C-05 recovery after the v7 dual-expiry change; not a validation result.

scenarios.name: v6_round2_high_dependence
scenarios.rationale: Same descriptive opportunity vector with stronger participant outcome dependence.
